author: SpeakerJohnson
text:
Congress should make life easier for hardworking families, not harder.

That’s why Republicans delivered pro-family policies, including:

✅ DOUBLING the child tax credit permanently
✅ Creating an adoption tax credit
✅ Establishing an education freedom tax credit to help parents cover school supplies and other educational resources
✅ Allowing parents to open tax-advantaged investment accounts to help jumpstart their kids’ American Dream

Every Democrat voted NO and AGAINST American families.

Republicans will keep fighting for you and your family — no matter how hard Democrats try to stop us.
